command: Investigate the current rules.md and create an independent source-driven Node workflow collector, then a complete source-cited Skill in this SAME run. Scope is the explicitly labelled audited acceptance model, never the original synes business. Core/SDK must not change. Call code-map {}, export-snapshot include [rules.md], read-source, import-conventions notes/sourceIds. Inspect output/case/manifest and identity schemas as needed. Use includeIdentityHelper=true, list identity.mjs in artifacts; the helper exports computeEntityId(projectId,kind,orderedSlots), computeRelationId(projectId,kind,from,to,qualifiers), computeEvidenceId(sourceId,hash,start,end,role). orderedSlots are {name,value} objects, never a dictionary. workflowState slots scopeId,workflowId,semanticKey; documentType slots scopeId,semanticKey. Scope comes from configSubset, project ID also; choose one stable workflowId for this document. Implement a SMALL text grammar for documented lines STATE -> STATE: trigger, guard. Recompute states, edges and exact trigger/guard text from EACH current source; also parse the documented Documents chain and its ordered key names, emitting documentType entities and relates_document edges with qualifiers.orderedKeys as those names. Preserve the source words rather than interpreting code. Use declared/static assertions with actual UTF-8 evidence. Do not turn the conflict variant sentence, logging order or /help into transitions. This collector need not parse TS/SQL or invent router or column bindings. Handle empty input/deleted source as successful empty replacement; never hard-code states/paths/conditions as output. Coverage capability workflow, sourceSetId from the input sourceSets, complete for the supported current declarations; sources missing should yield empty output. One extract stage with rules.md selector and at least one meaningful case requiring real computed entity IDs and a real relation ID. Case input is the exact exported CollectorInput with pluginId/version/stageId adjusted to the manifest. Write manifest, collector, case and input in a bundle, validate-plugin, repair only structured errors within budget. After activation CONTINUE export-topic-context topicId=purchase-workflow query=purchase view=workflow maxChars=80000. Import a concise TopicArtifact preserving the returned metadata and ALL gaps. Each explanatory line has [[claim:id]], original evidenceIds from context.sourceReferences. Use basis=declared,origin=static for original document claims; no AI-inferred claims without required gaps. Then export-skill name=purchase-workflow. Do not stop at activation; finish only with a fresh complete Skill. IMPORTANT implementation constraints: keep the collector below 120 lines. Do not implement glob matching, framework logic, generic config validation or extra capabilities. Sources are ALREADY selected by the host. Output dependencies:[]; the Core records and validates host source/sourceSet dependencies itself. Do not guess source-set dependency hashes/keys from selector IDs. If you do emit dependencies, they must exactly match the exported key and digest, so prefer the empty list. Use a regex with exactly THREE capture groups for transition lines: from, to, and rest; the rest is match[3], not match[4]. Split rest at its FIRST comma into trigger and guard. Do not reword conditions. Parse the Documents chain and ordered key tokens directly from that current line. No Core/SDK template collectors or output facts may be copied; generate the small document parser yourself from this project's current source.
